verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's 'Change history' docs (launchdarkly-docs-7) directly address tracking flag changes, and role/permission docs (launchdarkly-docs-36) plus API tokens (launchdarkly-docs-37) suggest attribution of who made changes. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming a full audit log capturing who/when/old-value/new-value in one place, nor any independent/community corroboration of the audit log's completeness or reliability. missing for 10: dedicated audit-log documentation detailing field-level before/after values, retention/export capabilities, and independent verification of accuracy.
